rules: Track consequential media handoffs with stable asset IDs; trivial implementation files do not require lineage records.
parent_asset_ids mean direct derivation such as crop, edit, animation, transcode or delivery derivative; reference_asset_ids mean influence without direct derivation.
Use the same asset ID when image, video, motion, the asset ledger and evidence refer to the same production asset.

production_stages: Approve the still master before motion or final derivatives.

execution_policy.iteration_rule: Repair one diagnosed defect at a time and repeat protected invariants on every edit iteration.
execution_policy.host_reference_rule: A local path is not automatically an image-model input; the executing host must confirm each required reference is actually available to the generator before the job is ready.

delivery: No generated or sourced image production is currently required.
evidence: Image scope must be reviewed before Compose / Choreograph is approved.

generation_policy.provider_strategy: Use a generated-video provider only when the website role earns it and the executing host can authenticate, generate, import and inspect the result.
generation_policy.approval_boundary: No paid generation is authorized by this empty template.
stop_conditions: Stop when the declared attempt, provider-interaction, or spend authority is exhausted.

hard_floors: The actual generated asset must be inspected before it can be accepted.
quality_gate.acceptance_rule: All declared hard floors must pass; an average score cannot hide a hard failure.
quality_gate.regeneration_rule: Regenerate only for a diagnosed fixable failure and only within the declared attempt and spend budget.

delivery: No generated or sourced video production is currently required.
accessibility: Provide a deliberate poster or static/reduced-motion equivalent for any future non-essential generated video.
evidence: Video scope and generation authority must be reviewed before paid generation or web integration.

accessibility_equivalents: No additional motion beyond normal interface feedback is currently required.
evidence: Motion scope must be reviewed before Compose / Choreograph is approved.

shared_rules: Do not add cross-runtime coordination until more than one consequential runtime interacts on the same surface or concern.
prohibited_conflicts: Do not allow two owners to control the same concern in the same scope without an explicit redesign of the orchestration plan.

evidence_contract.support_claim_rule: Evidence applies only to the exact environment rows observed; untested support remains planned or explicitly excluded.
